'''1999 GenCon UK Sunday tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG convention held in Loughborough University, Loughborough, England on 5 September 1999. [[Alex Tennet]] won it. It is known from Alex Tennet's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d52">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-26-gencon-uk-report-2-5-9-99-uk-dated52/ gencon-uk-report-2-5-9-99-uk-date], DeckTech (Alex "Greedo" Tennet, 26 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-26-gencon-uk-report-2-5-9-99-uk-dated52/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 September 1999
* '''Site:''' Loughborough University, Loughborough, England
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Alex Tennet]]
